name: TrueMile
long_description:
TrueMile is building an AI-native trucking company. We run our own fleet, using agents to find freight, plan loads, and coordinate drivers and brokers.

Our goal is to reduce empty miles, improve truck utilization, and lower the cost of moving goods. Operating the fleet ourselves lets us connect each decision to its outcome on the road and improve how we work.

We’re starting with human drivers. As autonomous trucks become available on our routes, we intend to put them to work within an established freight network.

Founder Harpreet Dhaliwal started running his family’s trucking business at 19 and has generated more than $7M in trucking revenue. The tools he built for that operation became TrueMile.

For recurring truckload freight and partnerships: harpreet@truemile.ai

launches.title: TrueMile: The AI-native trucking company
launches.tagline: Plan the fleet. Book the freight. Dispatch the driver. All run by AI.
launches.body:
Hi, I’m Harpreet, founder of TrueMile.

**TL;DR:** TrueMile is an AI-native trucking company. Starting with our own fleet, we use AI to plan loads, find freight, negotiate with brokers, and dispatch drivers. Over four months, AI-selected loads earned 17% more revenue per mile than the market average on dry van and 8% on reefer. Our trucks also averaged 10% more miles per month than the industry average.

**The problem: fleets leave money on the road when planning and execution can’t keep up**

Fleet profitability depends on which contracts to take and how to fill the empty legs between them. The highest-paying load can leave a truck empty or unavailable for a better commitment tomorrow.

In practice, planners are forced to react to today’s market one load at a time, rather than optimize margins across the fleet. They do this while handling calls, delays, cancellations, and breakdowns. Every handoff between planning, dispatch, brokers, and drivers adds another chance for delay or miscommunication.

**How TrueMile works**

<https://youtu.be/MRmZpD42ov4>

TrueMile combines mathematical optimization with AI agents that execute the plan:

* **Optimize the whole fleet.** Evaluate contracts, load assignments, and backhauls together, weighing market forecasts, revenue, costs, available hours, and driver commitments.
* **Source and negotiate freight.** Search load boards and contact brokers in parallel to secure loads that fit the plan.
* **Execute and adapt.** Dispatch drivers, keep customers updated, and rework assignments when plans change.A person approves every load and signs every rate confirmation.

A person still approves every load.

**The result**

More revenue per truck. Lower operating costs. Higher margins. AI lets us keep trucks productive and grow the fleet without growing office headcount at the same pace. Customers get consistent updates and dependable deliveries. Drivers get higher earning potential and more predictable schedules.

**The team**

[**Harpreet Dhaliwal**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harpreet-dhaliwal/) **(CEO)** took over his family's trucking business at 19 and led its turnaround, restructuring debt, upgrading the fleet and returning it to profitability. He holds an MS in Data Science.

[**Daniyar Abykhanov**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniyarabykhanov/) **(founding engineer)** built voice agents at Kazakhstan’s largest bank that took over the work of a 225-person call center. He played Counter-Strike professionally for Kazakhstan from ages 12 to 16 and has won three consecutive hackathons, including one run by Google.

**Our ask**

* **Shippers with recurring truckload freight in Texas and the Sunbelt:** we’re taking on two dedicated-lane partners this quarter. [Book a call](https://calendly.com/harpreet-truemile/30min).
* Know a logistics, supply chain, or transportation leader who’s tired of unreliable capacity? We’d love an intro: [harpreet@truemile.ai](mailto:harpreet@truemile.ai).

Learn more at [truemile.ai](http://truemile.ai).
